insights: The original fourPointProperty_from_avoiding_configs was false under the product/Chebyshev metric on ℝ×ℝ: unit-square corners (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1) are mutually equidistant (sup-distance 1), so distinctDistances=1 while avoiding every named 2-distance config. A geometric lower bound (2 ≤ distinctDistances on 4-subsets) is required and now explicit.
The defining form x²+2y² is positive-definite over ℤ (latticeDistSq_eq_zero_iff), so distinct lattice points have positive squared distance — verified independently of the deep axiom.
